mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_record ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, file_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, original_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, object_key VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, bucket_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, content_type VARCHAR(128), file_size BIGINT NOT NULL, file_md5 CHAR(32) NOT NULL, file_ext VARCHAR(32), storage_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_file_record_file_id (file_id), KEY idx_file_record_md5_size (file_md5, file_size), KEY idx_file_record_status_created_at (status, created_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id, original_name, object_key, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, storage_type, status, created_at, updated_at FROM file_record WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'NORMAL' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, file_id, original_name, object_key, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, storage_type, status, created_at, updated_at FROM file_record WHERE file_md5 = #{fileMd5} AND file_size = #{fileSize} AND status = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE file_record SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
